# Sleepers and Expert Targets

<sub>Proposed by the synthesis, not on the user's list.</sub>

**Summary.** The best bargains in our auction sit in the middle of the 144-player pool. That is where experts rank players 15 to 40 spots above their market price: Alexander-Walker, Rollins, Garland, Daniels, the Jazz trio and Ty Jerome. At the top, Murray, Reaves, LaMelo and Amen Thompson are worth only a small premium. Giannis and Durant are fair buys, not discounts. Spend the money you save on the 51 to 100 range. Finish with 1 USD centers and role flyers.

## How to spot a real bargain

Rankings and projections tell you how good a player is. ADP and average auction cost tell you what the room will pay. Bid on the gap between them, not on the rank alone. If experts rank a player 30th and the market has him 70th, pay roughly a 50th-pick price, not first-round money. ([09-01](https://youtu.be/skKXe2CRl8Q?t=579))

Chase only large gaps. A gap of a few spots leaves no margin if the player disappoints. A gap of 15 to 20 spots still pays off if he underperforms. Leagues are won by players who finish about 40 spots above their draft position. The widest gaps in our pool belong to Nickeil Alexander-Walker (experts see top 35 to 50, market in the 50s to 60s), Ryan Rollins (experts see top 50, ESPN about 105), Ty Jerome (Lloyd says take him in the 70s or 80s against a Yahoo ADP near 115) and Keyonte George. ([10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=227), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1796), [Nickeil Alexander-Walker](../profiles/players/nickeil-alexander-walker.md), [Ryan Rollins](../profiles/players/ryan-rollins.md), [Ty Jerome](../profiles/players/ty-jerome.md), [Keyonte George](../profiles/players/keyonte-george.md))

Most of the value sits between picks 51 and 100. There, players can beat their ADP by 10 to 40 spots. In our 12-team league that is roughly rounds 5 to 9 of 12, the middle of the 144 drafted players. Plan the budget so you still hold real money when these players are nominated. Do not spend it all on stars in the first hour. ([09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=1844))

## Why these players are cheap

Overlooked teams. Drafters often skip players on teams nobody watches. Experts say the community is still very skeptical of Jazz players after the tanking years. That points to discounts on Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Keyonte George. Bid on these three with confidence up to the expert ranges in their lines. Rollins on the Bucks and Jerome on Memphis are each called the best target on their team. ([09-27](https://youtu.be/CRLSsoGhb2w?t=1594), [08-05](https://youtu.be/CI4k8ofUXXk?t=1037), [Lauri Markkanen](../profiles/players/lauri-markkanen.md), [Jaren Jackson Jr.](../profiles/players/jaren-jackson.md), [Keyonte George](../profiles/players/keyonte-george.md), [Ryan Rollins](../profiles/players/ryan-rollins.md), [Ty Jerome](../profiles/players/ty-jerome.md))

Role fear. A player's price drops when drafters think he may lose his starting job or share minutes. That is value only if you believe he starts. These players are in that spot: Dyson Daniels and Alexander-Walker (Lu Dort's minutes), CJ McCollum (starting over Dort), Day'Ron Sharpe (ahead of Mo Wagner and Danny Wolf), Neemias Queta (over Mitchell Robinson), Yves Missi (over Derik Queen) and Jeremiah Fears (over Herb Jones). Pay full expert value for the ones whose role you trust. Keep the rest at 1 USD. ([09-21](https://youtu.be/egRrai3Ax38?t=822), [Dyson Daniels](../profiles/players/dyson-daniels.md), [Nickeil Alexander-Walker](../profiles/players/nickeil-alexander-walker.md), [CJ McCollum](../profiles/players/cj-mccollum.md), [Day'Ron Sharpe](../profiles/players/dayron-sharpe.md), [Neemias Queta](../profiles/players/neemias-queta.md), [Yves Missi](../profiles/players/yves-missi.md), [Jeremiah Fears](../profiles/players/jeremiah-fears.md))

Injury and age. A risky player can be good value when the discount is large enough to price in the risk. Kyrie Irving (ACL), Anthony Davis (experts set the bar at about 60 games), Zach Edey (foot and ankle), Paul George (knees) and Jalen Suggs (about 20 missed games) all fit this case. Joel Embiid is the hardest call. His 40 to 50 games leave empty head-to-head weeks, and the Sixers have three back-to-backs in our playoffs. So treat 19 USD as his ceiling, not a target. ([10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=304), [Kyrie Irving](../profiles/players/kyrie-irving.md), [Anthony Davis](../profiles/players/anthony-davis.md), [Zach Edey](../profiles/players/zach-edey.md), [Paul George](../profiles/players/paul-george.md), [Jalen Suggs](../profiles/players/jalen-suggs.md), [Joel Embiid](../profiles/players/joel-embiid.md))

## Where the experts disagree

The experts do not agree on every target. On Amen Thompson, Josh values him at about 40 USD. Lloyd calls him a third-round pick, about 28 to 30, if his blocks and FG% do not come back now that he is off point guard. On Zach Edey, one mock buyer paid 20 USD while Josh capped him at 11 USD. On Anthony Davis, one expert gives him 30 USD of per-game value but would buy only at a discount. Our room paid 54 USD for him last season. In each case, bid to the cautious side's number unless the early-season checks have already gone your way. ([Amen Thompson](../profiles/players/amen-thompson.md), [Zach Edey](../profiles/players/zach-edey.md), [Anthony Davis](../profiles/players/anthony-davis.md))

The markets also split, which is why our own room matters. Durant goes much higher on Yahoo than on ESPN, while experts settle in the low 40s USD. Reaves, Jamal Murray, Brandon Miller and George are all far cheaper on ESPN than on Yahoo. Our league's past prices do not always follow either site. Daniels went for 28 USD last season, while Alexander-Walker went for 1 USD. Expect our room to chase some of these players. Stop at the expert number, not the room's. ([Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Austin Reaves](../profiles/players/austin-reaves.md), [Jamal Murray](../profiles/players/jamal-murray.md), [Brandon Miller](../profiles/players/brandon-miller.md), [Keyonte George](../profiles/players/keyonte-george.md), [Dyson Daniels](../profiles/players/dyson-daniels.md), [Nickeil Alexander-Walker](../profiles/players/nickeil-alexander-walker.md), [09-01](https://youtu.be/skKXe2CRl8Q?t=579))

## Playoff schedule and deadline checks

Our playoffs are weeks 19 to 21 and end 2027-03-28. Houston plays only 10 games in those weeks, which trims Durant and Amen Thompson. Indiana plays 3, 4 and 3 (Ivica Zubac). Brooklyn has 10 games (Sharpe, Randle-style volume on a thin schedule). Egor Dëmin has a 3-4-3. Memphis's 4-4-4 is a bonus for Jerome. Dallas also plays 4-4-4, but Irving may sit some of the league-high 16 back-to-backs. Jaden McDaniels has a two-game semifinal week, and LaMelo Ball has a two-game week of March 15. ([Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Amen Thompson](../profiles/players/amen-thompson.md), [Ivica Zubac](../profiles/players/ivica-zubac.md), [Day'Ron Sharpe](../profiles/players/dayron-sharpe.md), [Egor Dëmin](../profiles/players/egor-demin.md), [Ty Jerome](../profiles/players/ty-jerome.md), [Kyrie Irving](../profiles/players/kyrie-irving.md), [Jaden McDaniels](../profiles/players/jaden-mcdaniels.md), [LaMelo Ball](../profiles/players/lamelo-ball.md))

Watch trade news before the 2027-03-04 deadline. A trade to a contender would gut Norman Powell's value because his case rests on being Chicago's top usage option. Davis, Jamal Murray and Rollins also carry trade talk. If you own any of them in February, decide by the deadline whether to sell. ([Norman Powell](../profiles/players/norman-powell.md), [Anthony Davis](../profiles/players/anthony-davis.md), [Jamal Murray](../profiles/players/jamal-murray.md), [Ryan Rollins](../profiles/players/ryan-rollins.md))

## Bidding plan by stage

Early. Pay fair prices for the stars and do not chase. Giannis at about 60 to 62 USD only makes sense for a punt FT% build. Durant is fair in the low 40s, and the 50 USD range is a stretch. Among guards, Jamal Murray is the one worth pushing into the mid to high 30s, because experts see a top 12 to 14 finish with no weak category. ([Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Jamal Murray](../profiles/players/jamal-murray.md))

Middle. This is where to win the draft. Go to about 20 USD for Alexander-Walker, 20 to 25 USD for Darius Garland and 18 to 24 USD for Daniels. Jackson Jr. is a strong buy in the high teens. Rollins is one of the best value plays in the pool, and auction averages for him are only about 2 USD. Get him before the room notices. ([09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=1844), [Nickeil Alexander-Walker](../profiles/players/nickeil-alexander-walker.md), [Darius Garland](../profiles/players/darius-garland.md), [Dyson Daniels](../profiles/players/dyson-daniels.md), [Jaren Jackson Jr.](../profiles/players/jaren-jackson.md), [Ryan Rollins](../profiles/players/ryan-rollins.md))

Late. Fill your last spots with cheap centers and role flyers whose value depends on minutes: Queta, Jakob Poeltl, Isaiah Hartenstein, Missi, Isaiah Jackson and Collin Murray-Boyles. Pay 1 to 5 USD. Check the starting jobs in the first week. Players who lose their role can be cut for waiver adds, and you have up to 6 acquisitions per week. ([Neemias Queta](../profiles/players/neemias-queta.md), [Jakob Poeltl](../profiles/players/jakob-poeltl.md), [Isaiah Hartenstein](../profiles/players/isaiah-hartenstein.md), [Yves Missi](../profiles/players/yves-missi.md), [Isaiah Jackson](../profiles/players/isaiah-jackson.md), [Collin Murray-Boyles](../profiles/players/collin-murray-boyles.md), [09-21](https://youtu.be/egRrai3Ax38?t=822))
